{{Quote|The Banking Clan has hidden huge factories on Muunilinst, building huge droid armies and massive warships. We must act quickly!|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="CWC1" />}}
The '''Battle of Muunilinst''' was a major engagement that took place within four weeks after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], initiated by the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] to put a curb on [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] funding and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] production, as well as destroy the factories on the planet that produced huge droid armies and massive warships.<ref name="CWC1" /> Storming the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the Republic assaulted the main city of [[Harnaidan]], using a [[The Muunilinst 10|team]] of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] to eliminate key enemy defenses within the city. Meanwhile, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led the space assault, taking out various separatist [[Space station/Legends|orbital stations.]]
This was the first battle [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] was seen in, and caused major Republic casualties when he appeared. The [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer droids]] also made their first appearance, jousting with the similar [[clone lancer trooper]]s of the [[Lancer Battalion]]. Despite heavy Separatist resistance, the Republic nonetheless succeeded in capturing the Separatist command, with the efforts of [[The Muunilinst 10]] and other contributing to this. The battle would also signify the Jedi's first encounter with the minion of [[Dooku]]'s known as [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==Background==
{{Quote|I doubt even Master Qui-Gon could have prepared a Jedi for this.|Kenobi's thoughts during the battle prelude|<ref name="CWC1" />}}
[[File:MuunilinstMTTs-TCWCG.jpg|thumb|left|180px|MTTs deploying battle droids on Muunilinst]]
The battle was arranged in a meeting between [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]], within four weeks after [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="CWC1" /> Assigned to route the Confederacy from Muunilinst,<ref name="YearbyYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> Anakin and Obi-Wan were enlisted by Palpatine to lead an assault on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], home of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. The Intergalactic Banking Clan was a heavy monetary, [[Warship/Legends|warship]], and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] contributor to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], and the Chancellor believed they could deal the Separatists a major blow by capturing the IGBC's headquarters. Despite concern from Yoda and Kenobi, Skywalker was made commander of the Republic spaceborne forces.<ref name="CWC1" />

Immediately afterward, a large Republic force was mustered for this task, and was loaded aboard a flotilla of ''Acclamator''-class assault ships. Before leaving, Anakin took the opportunity to bid farewell to his wife [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="CWC1" />

==The battle==
===The surface battle===
{{Quote|Those guns are destroying our forward positions! The Republic is breaking through!|San Hill responding to SPHA-T fire|<ref name="CWC4" />}}
[[File:IGBCMuunilinst.jpg|thumb|left|200px|InterGalactic Banking Clan members presiding over the battle]]
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet of [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator-I''-class assault ships]] led by Anakin and Obi-Wan, encountered resistance as it entered the orbit of the planet Muunilinst.<ref name="CWC2" /> Despite losing several gunships to enemy missile fire, the Republic's invasion force, including [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] and the assault ships carrying [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery/Legends|SPHA walkers]],<ref name="CWC4" /> managed to land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], where they engaged the Separatist [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] in front of the city of [[Harnaidan]], while Anakin led the flight groups against Separatist fighter craft in orbit.<ref name="CWC2" /> Hundreds of assault ships landed throughout the heavily fortified world, with their hulls filled with troops and vehicles, even though they took losses. They proceeded to besiege the cities.<ref name="TNEC" />

The Republic forces made considerable progress during the initial stage of the Harnaidan siege, with SPHA artillery pieces concentrating fire on the ground just before the clone front lines. Any units coming to the front lines on the Separatist side were almost instantaneously decimated by artillery barrage, forcing the droids to pull back. Buildings fell quickly to the amount of artillery firepower as the SPHA batteries were brought to the frontlines, which caused much collateral damage.<ref name="CWC4" />

====Advanced Recon Commando mission====
{{Quote|You are the best; the elite.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="CWC2" />}}
[[File:Muunilinst_10.png|thumb|right|200px|The remaining members of the Muunilinst 10]]
{{Main|The Muunilinst 10}}
During the initial landing, the specialized landing craft of the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] of [[The Muunilinst 10]] was deployed to go on a special mission within Harnaidan. These ARCs were led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fordo]]. Pulling away from the main force, it entered the city with little difficulty.<ref name="CWC2" />

However, they were shot down by a missile launcher-wielding battle droid, and the gunship crashed into a street. After taking out surrounding droid snipers, taking one casualty in the process, the troops found they were cut off from their original drop zone, but still made their way to the enemy command center. Along the way, they faced off against an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]], which they successfully destroyed with a ARC Trooper shooting it from inside, blowing it to pieces.<ref name="CWC3" />

After reaching the Separatist command center, the ARCs eliminated surrounding droids and proceeded to lay explosive charges on a large cannon that was bombarding the Republic forces. Once the cannon was destroyed, they rappelled up to the roof of the command center to await Kenobi.<ref name="CWC3" /> The destruction of the artillery gun contributed to CIS commander [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill's]] fear about the battle, as he now believed that the Republic artillery reached far enough into the city to blow up the cannon.<ref name="CWC4" />

====The joust====
{{Quote|Mount up.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="CWC4" />}}
The Republic's initial success panicked San Hill, and he turned to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]], who was present, and demanded to know why [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] would dispatch him to the battle if all he was going to do was stand around. Durge responded by briefly grappling Hill, and then decided to move into action with a contingent of [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer droids]]. Leaving the CIS command post, Durge and his force of droids moved to the front lines and tore towards the heart of the Republic's forces, causing huge casualties in the Republic ranks and destroying nearly all the SPHA walkers.<ref name="CWC4" />

[[File:Iglancerdroid.jpg|thumb|left|175px|An IG Lancer Droid on his mount]]
Durge's success spurred General Kenobi to lead a team of [[clone lancer trooper]]s out to meet Durge's forces. The two bands of swoop riders entered into a vicious mass joust, both clone and droid alike being impaled or thrown aside like debris. Obi-Wan and Durge both slew a good share of the enemy. As both sides sustained massive casualties, the two commanders spotted one another and engaged in personal combat.<ref name="CWC8" />

On the first jousting pass, Durge deprived Kenobi of both his lance and helmet. In response, Kenobi drew his lightsaber and on the second pass, sliced Durge's lance to pieces and destroyed his bike. As he charged in to skewer his dismounted opponent, Durge, in an incredible display of strength and reflex, caught Kenobi's swoop by the steering vanes and flipped the Jedi off. Wielding the bike as a club, Durge then charged Kenobi. Kenobi sliced it to pieces and [[Shiak|stabbed Durge through the chest]]. Durge merely laughed, surprising Kenobi.<ref name="CWC8" />

Durge's decentralized [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] physique allowed him to easily survive the stabbing, and he proceeded to beat Kenobi with his fists. Kenobi, with his saber still lodged in Durge's chest, couldn't retaliate, and was lifted bodily off the ground by a solid punch to the gut. Durge proceeded to fire at Kenobi with a [[Gatling gauntlet|small rapid projectile launcher]], but the Jedi deflected the slugs with the Force. Switching to a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]], Durge's attacks were again deflected and the flamethrower was crushed with the Force.<ref name="CWC8" />

Brandishing a massive flail, he prepared to finish off Kenobi, but Kenobi used the Force to summon his lightsaber back to him and severed the flail's chain. Though he drew his two blaster pistols, Durge was disarmed before he could use them. Switching on the energy shields built into his gauntlets, he deflected Kenobi's lightsaber slashes, but was unable to adequately counterattack.<ref name="CWC8" />

[[File:Kenobi-and-Durge.png|thumb|right|200px|Obi-Wan Kenobi fighting Durge]]
Kenobi pressed his advantage, Durge barely blocking, until finally, Kenobi [[Cho sun/Legends|sliced of Durge's right arm]] and [[Sai tok/Legends|bisected him through the middle]]. After seemingly defeating Durge, he salvaged a remaining swoop on the field and proceeded to join the ARC troopers. As Kenobi jetted off into the city, he failed to notice Durge's body pulling itself back together.<ref name="CWC8" />

====Infiltrating the command tower====
{{Quote|Ah yes. I believe you were surrendering.|Kenobi to San Hill|<ref name="CWC9" />}}
After the joust and battle with Durge, General Kenobi rushed through the city to the command tower, where he met up with the Muunilinst 10. Blasting open the roof of the structure with explosives, the troops, led by Kenobi, rappelled into the control room and quickly destroyed all the security droids.<ref name="CWC9" />

Capturing San Hill, Kenobi offered to spare his life in exchange for an unconditional surrender. Before Hill had a chance to answer, Durge smashed through the tower window into the room on a jetpack. However, he was quickly shot down by concentrated fire from the clone troopers and ARC's. Hill took the opportunity to take cover under the situation table.<ref name="CWC9" />

[[File:Kenobi_and_Durge2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kenobi facing Durge a second time]]
Thinking Durge to be dead, the troopers approached the smoking crater they had made, only to be knocked aside by a massive fleshy arm. Durge climbed from the crater, all his armor save a few, small fragments along with his helmet and gloves blasted off, revealing his true Gen'Dai form. He quickly attacked Kenobi, driving the Jedi atop the situation table, which Durge snapped in half with his fists. He was then attacked by clones rappelling down on [[Electrified grappling hook|grappling hooks]] which they attached to him.<ref name="CWC9" />

The blaster fire had no effect, and Durge simply ripped the lines from the wall with his sheer strength, toppling the clones. Charging Kenobi, Durge disarmed him and almost literally absorbed him into his body, hoping to suffocate him, and then approached the ARC commander, Fordo. Fordo then fired a taser at Durge, electrocuting him. This only succeeded in enraging the Gen'Dai, who charged Fordo, knocking aside the clones in his way.<ref name="CWC9" />

However, before Durge could kill him, he suddenly bloated to massive size and exploded. Kenobi had used the Force to push outward and destroy Durge's body from the inside out. Commenting on how much of a mess he had made, Kenobi turned back to Hill, who promptly surrendered.<ref name="CWC9" />

===The space battle===
{{Quote|This is no droid pilot&hellip;|Anakin Skywalker, concentrating on Asajj Ventress|<ref name="CWC11" />}}
[[File:BattleOfMuunilinstSpace-CWChapter10.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The space portion of the Battle of Muunilinst]]
Meanwhile, Anakin Skywalker was leading the clone navy in a fierce space battle above Muunilinst. Several Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] engaged the Confederacy's [[InterGalactic Banking Clan gun platform/Legends|gun platforms]]. The Republic's [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrents]] were engaged by large numbers of [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class]] starfighters. Skywalker ordered the clone pilots to disengage, and destroyed large numbers of the enemy fighters with his proton torpedoes.<ref name="CWC10" />

Pursued by yet more enemy fighters, he ordered his clones to fire all their concussion missiles across the bow of [[Cruiser 8]], much to the confusion of the clones. He flew past the ship as the missiles started arriving; the missiles hit the swarm of fighters pursuing him, destroying a large number of them. Trailed by missiles, Skywalker flew through the hangar of one of the gun platforms. The missiles collided with various objects within the hangar and destroyed the gun platform from the inside. Sustained turbolaser fire from the Republic capital ships destroyed another one.<ref name="CWC10" />

Only a few Separatist fighters remained, but a [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|mysterious ship]] appeared and engaged the Republic forces, annihilating [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]]. Skywalker personally engaged the fighter, pursuing it into the atmosphere and through the streets of Harnaidan.<ref name="CWC10" /> When the pilot, a mysterious [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] protégé of Dooku, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the impetuous young Jedi followed, disobeying a direct order from Obi-Wan, leading to a [[Duel on Yavin 4|fateful duel]].<ref name="CWC11" />

==Conclusion and aftermath==
{{Quote|The IG Banking Clan has surrendered! The day is ours! The Republic is victorious!|Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=IGBCsurrender-CW20.flac|<ref name="CWC20" />}}
[[File:Voolvif2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Voolvif Monn mops up.]]
Having surrendered, San Hill was taken into custody, although he later escaped. The majority of the battle droids were deactivated as [[Voolvif Monn]] and the clone army battled through the Droid Army in Harnaidan, and the battle was won for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="CWC20" />

Meanwhile, Anakin tracked Asajj Ventress down to the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]. There, Ventress killed the clone troopers accompanying Skywalker and destroyed his ship.<ref name="CWC17">{{CW|17}}</ref> Anakin and Ventress engaged in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Duel on Yavin 4|duel]] through the jungles<ref name="CWC18">{{CW|18}}</ref> and on top of a [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Temple]].<ref name="CWC19" /> In the end, Ventress was defeated, though not killed. This event was of some significance, as in the process, Anakin was pushed a little closer to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Years down the road, he would fall completely and become Darth Vader.<ref name="CWC19" />

After the duel, Skywalker returned to Muunilinst in Ventress's fighter and was scolded by Kenobi for his hotheadedness. Kenobi noted his concern in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] interest in his apprentice. At that point, Kenobi received a transmission from General [[Daakman Barrek]] on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], a distress call, which would lead to [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|another significant turn of events]] with the introduction of a new foe: General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]].<ref name="CWC20" />

==Behind the scenes==
The scene in which the Republic and Separatist forces fight in mounted combat on swoops is meant to resemble a futuristic version of a Medieval joust, further supporting [[George Lucas]]' ideas and plans for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that are related to things such as chivalry and knights.<ref name="CWCDVDC">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' DVD commentary''</ref>

Although no explicit figure has been given of the size of the Republic assault force, a passage in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', describes the Republic besieging the "unassailable castle keep" of the planet Muunilinst with "sheer numbers&hellip; hundreds of assault ships, each one groaning from the weight of troopers and war machines".<ref name="TNEC" /> If these ships were [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] and were filled to their maximum specifications as would be expected, at least 3.2 million clone troopers would have been deployed to the battle. The main assault ships in this era were the ''Acclamator''-class and the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Supercruiser]], which was able to take even more troops. At minimal figure, eleven ''Acclamator''-class warships are seen together above Muunilinst in ''Clone Wars'', which would give a minimum troop capacity of at least 176,000. This does not account for the ones that landed on the planet and deployed troops and artillery walkers.<ref name="TNEC" />

The debate over numbers at Muunilinst is part of a wider disagreement among fans as to the size of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the scale of forces involved in the Clone Wars: a book-level [[canon]] source<ref name="RCHC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> states explicitly that the GAR could deploy only 1.2 million clone troopers in total at this stage in the war, rising later to a total muster strength of three million; this is contradicted by many other, higher-canon sources, and many fans believe that these numbers are unworkable. They argue that other evidence indicates clone forces numbering in millions of [[Division/Legends|divisions]].<ref name="ITWAOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', numerous canon sources</ref> For fuller discussion, see [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends#Numbers|here]].<ref name="VF">''Various forums, including [[TheForce.net]]'' and stardestroyer.net</ref>
